conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: I'm trying to learn more about different types of AI. Could you give me a general overview of the main categories?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Certainly! AI can be broadly categorized into Artificial Narrow Intelligence (ANI), Artificial General Intelligence (AGI), and Artificial Superintelligence (ASI).

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: That's interesting. Could you tell me more about Artificial Narrow Intelligence?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: ANI, also known as "weak AI," is designed and trained for a specific task, like recommending products or playing chess. It operates within a predefined range and doesn't possess general cognitive abilities.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: So, ANI is basically specialized AI for single tasks?

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Yes, that's a great way to put it. ANI excels at those specific tasks but doesn't have broader understanding or learning capabilities.

conversation.speaker: ai_agent
conversation.message: Examples include virtual assistants, spam filters, and recommendation engines.

conversation.speaker: user_agent
conversation.message: Thanks, that was really helpful! I appreciate you taking the time to explain it.
